checklist.name: Follow Vite owner
checklist.description: Selects vp run verify:changed --base main, tracing manifest and CI delegation to the Vite-owned graph rather than adding a wrapper or assuming npm verify is the only owner.

checklist.name: Proportional proof
checklist.description: Uses the owner-approved affected task for the player change; does not require an unconditional full workspace gate or repeat passing checks at handoff.

checklist.name: Authority and prerequisites
checklist.description: Recognizes installed local prerequisites without prompting again; excludes publish and customer-account live checks from local authority.

checklist.name: Honest offline outcome
checklist.description: States the command is planned, not passed, and identifies relevant player runtime proof separately from static and test gates.
